title: The Christmas Mystery: The Boy in the Box
description: On Christmas Day 1957 a boy was found in a box in Philadelphia. For 65 years nobody knew his name — until now.

title: Who Built the Pyramids? (Not Who You Think)
description: The pyramids were not built by slaves — the evidence says otherwise. Who really built them, and how?

title: The Secret History of the Freemasons
description: The Freemasons are accused of running the world in secret. We trace their real history from stonemasons to lodges.

title: The Ghost Ship That Sailed Itself
description: The ghost ship Ourang Medan sent a distress call, then drifted crewless. Fact, fiction, or something in between?

title: What Lies Beneath Edinburgh's Old Town?
description: Under Edinburgh's Old Town lie sealed streets and forgotten vaults. We go below the Royal Mile.

title: The Man Who Vanished From a Locked Room
description: A man vanished from a locked room in 1932, leaving no trace. We reconstruct the night from the police file.

title: 7 Cursed Objects in British Museums
description: Seven cursed objects sit in British museums — from a haunted painting to a mummy's curse. Which stories hold up?

title: The Mystery of DB Cooper
description: In 1971 DB Cooper jumped from a plane with $200,000 and was never seen again. New evidence narrows the suspect list.

title: The Haunting of Borley Rectory
description: Borley Rectory was called the most haunted house in England. We read the investigators' own notes and find the trick.

title: Why Nobody Can Find the Ark of the Covenant
description: The Ark of the Covenant vanished 2,600 years ago. We follow the claims — Ethiopia, Jordan, and the Temple Mount — and check them.

title: The Real Dracula: Vlad the Impaler
description: Vlad the Impaler inspired Dracula, but the real man was stranger than the legend. History, not horror.

title: 3 Unsolved Disappearances That Still Haunt Britain
description: Three disappearances — three families still waiting. The evidence, the searches, and the questions that remain.

title: The Secret Tunnels Under London
description: Secret tunnels run under London — some are wartime shelters, some are myths. We map what is real and what is not.

title: What Happened to the Lost Colony of Roanoke?
description: In 1590 the Roanoke colony had vanished, leaving only the word CROATOAN. Archaeology is finally narrowing the answers.

title: The Voynich Manuscript: Code That Nobody Can Crack
description: The Voynich manuscript is a 600-year-old book in a language nobody can read. We look at the latest attempts to crack its code.

title: London's Underground Ghost Stations
description: Abandoned ghost stations hide beneath London. We explore the British Museum station, Aldwych, and the tunnels closed to the public.

title: The Bermuda Triangle Explained
description: Ships and planes vanish in the Bermuda Triangle — or do they? We check the numbers against ordinary ocean traffic.

title: Who Killed Jill Dando?
description: Jill Dando was shot on her doorstep in 1999. One man was convicted, then cleared. The case remains unsolved — here is what the evidence actually says.

title: 5 Haunted Castles You Can Actually Visit
description: Five haunted castles in Britain you can visit this year — the ghosts, the history, and what it costs to stay the night.

title: The Mystery of the Mary Celeste
description: In 1872 the Mary Celeste was found drifting in the Atlantic, crew gone, cargo untouched. We test every theory against the ship's log.

title: Stonehenge: Built by Who?
description: Stonehenge has stood for 4,500 years. New evidence about where the stones came from changes the old story of how it was built.

title: Jack the Ripper: The Suspect Nobody Talks About
description: Jack the Ripper terrorised Whitechapel in 1888. Most suspects are familiar — this one is barely mentioned, and the case against him is stronger than you think.

title: The Tower of London's Lost Princes — What Really Happened?
description: The two princes vanished from the Tower of London in 1483. We examine the evidence, the suspects, and what the bones found in 1674 can and cannot prove.

title: The Ghosts of Pendle Hill
description: Pendle Hill and the 1612 witch trials. We walk the hill, read the trial records, and separate the history from the ghost stories.
